gaps.sentence: The results were inconclusive. ___, the team repeated the whole experiment.
gaps.explanation: The inconclusive results caused the repetition: Therefore is the only result linker.

gaps.sentence: The delegates arrived early ___ have time to network.
gaps.explanation: 'So as to + infinitive' = in order to, a formal purpose linker.

gaps.sentence: ___ they promise rapid results, such diets rarely work.
gaps.explanation: 'Although' introduces the clause 'they promise rapid results'.

gaps.sentence: He spends money ___ it grew on trees.
gaps.explanation: 'As if it grew on trees' — the unreal comparison justifies the criticism.

gaps.sentence: After years of setbacks, the tunnel was ___ completed in 2019.
gaps.explanation: 'Eventually' = in the end, after a long delay or difficulty.

gaps.sentence: ___ it rains all weekend, the ceremony will still be held outdoors.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a possible (not yet real) condition.

gaps.sentence: Scarcely had she opened the letter ___ she burst into tears.
gaps.explanation: 'Scarcely... when' marks the immediate consequence of the first event.

gaps.sentence: ___ was the meal exquisite, but the service was impeccable too.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only' at the front triggers inversion (Not only was...) and pairs with 'but also'.
